headline: BSP_Game_Render (004ca440) recovered in full. The begin/finish pair is D3D9 BeginScene and EndScene+Present, not a lost-device test: renderer vtable 00d5f0a8 +0Ch reaches device +A4h, and +10h/+14h both reach 00b2d8e0. The +10h argument comes from 004c9a00, which formats a PNG path, so the selector 00e188ad is screenshot capture. Interface level 00e08310 chooses between a job-pool 3D scene (level 1) and two ortho map views (levels 2 and 3); level 1 is the only path that skips the inline world view 00735b50. The job pool drains last in first out.

tooling_problems: Ghidra's stored bodies for 004c6c30, 004ca1f0, 004bfbf0, 00503510, 00535430 and 0059d7b0 are truncated, so `bsp.py ghidra disasm <addr> --start <near end>` refuses the address; RET sizes had to come from the exported assembly.txt tails.

`bsp.py show <addr> --asm` reads exports from the main checkout, not the worktree, so the worktree path exports/bsp/functions/<addr>/ does not exist locally; assembly tails had to be read from J:/PROG/battlestations-pacific-decompile/exports/bsp.
`bsp.py ghidra export` has no --asm flag, so assembly is only written as a side effect of `show --asm`.
Ghidra has no function at 004b4820, 004bd080, 004bd0b0 or 00be3020, so `ghidra decompile` fails there and disasm-raw was needed.
